derivation: Written by hand from the fixture's five intentional errors and how the engine's reader propagates them; not copied from a run.

diagnostics.why: ERROR 1: `title  re_broken_syntax.0001.t` has no '='; the reader takes `title` as a key and finds the next token where '=' belongs
ERROR 2: the trigger block opened on line 28 is never closed, so `option` is read as a trigger
ERROR 2 continued: event 0002's own '}' closes the trigger block, so event 0003 is read as a field of event 0002

ERROR 4: a number is a legal key in the grammar (random_list weights, history dates); in an event it is an unknown field. ERROR 3's extra '}' closes event 0002 and cancels ERROR 2's missing one, so no brace error is reported for either
ERROR 5 consequence: the unterminated string runs to the end of the file, so event 0005's block (opened on line 64) is never closed
ERROR 5: the quoted string has no closing quote; the catalogue has no engine text for this, hence the package-local id
